title: n8n Workflow Automation
wrapper_note:
the upstream image already runs as the unprivileged node user (uid 1000), so this
entrypoint is not about privileges: it only adds the optional public-URL wiring for
webhook and form links - see src/entrypoint.sh.
wrapper_note_readme: - **Entrypoint wrapper** (not a privilege shim): the image already runs as the unprivileged `node` user; `src/entrypoint.sh` only wires up the optional public URL described in the next bullet and then hands over to the upstream `docker-entrypoint.sh` through `tini`.
user_mode_text: 上游镜像本身支持非 root；entrypoint 包装只做「公共链接」接线
user_mode_cons:
- 上游镜像本来就以非 root 的 `node`（uid 1000）运行，`user: "1000:1000"` 直接沿用，不需要为了权限改写任何路径。
- 覆盖 entrypoint 的唯一原因是 n8n 的 webhook / 表单 / OAuth 回调链接需要一个公共地址（`WEBHOOK_URL`），
  而镜像只能默认 `http://localhost:5678/`。包装脚本从数据目录读取可选的 `public-url.txt` 注入该变量，
  再通过 `tini` 把控制权交回上游 `docker-entrypoint.sh`；不写配置时不改变任何行为。
healthcheck_note: 探测 n8n 官方就绪探针 `/healthz/readiness`：初始化期间返回 503（容器显示 starting）， 数据库迁移完成、可以对外服务后返回 200（healthy）。`start_period` 给了 120s 宽限，首次启动在慢盘上也不会被误判。
license_notes:
n8n is **fair-code**, not an OSI-approved open-source project: the
Sustainable Use License allows free internal and personal use, but not
reselling n8n itself as a service. See
https://docs.n8n.io/sustainable-use-license/ for the exact terms. Only the
official Docker Hub image is used here; no upstream source code is
redistributed.
descript: n8n is a self-hosted workflow automation platform. On a visual canvas you connect 400+ apps, databases and AI models to automate repetitive work - sync files, send notifications, run scheduled jobs, enrich data - writing code only where you need it. This app runs the official Docker Hub image as a non-root container on your NAS and keeps every workflow, credential and execution history in an application data folder, so nothing is lost on restart or update.
important: Requires DockerEngine (the App Center installs it if missing); add a registry mirror in DockerEngine if your NAS cannot reach Docker Hub. Workflows, credentials, the SQLite database and the encryption key all live in the application data folder - back it up before uninstalling with data removal: without the encryption key saved credentials can no longer be decrypted. Webhook and form links default to http://localhost:5678; set your NAS address in public-url.txt to make them reachable from other devices.
release_note: 1. First release: n8n 2.41.3 from Docker Hub, running as a non-root container on your NAS. Workflows, credentials and execution history are kept in the application data folder.
data_notes: All state lives in the application data folder: `config` holds the encryption key, `database.sqlite` the workflows, credentials and execution history, `nodes/` community nodes, `storage/` binary files, and `public-url.txt` the optional public address.
design_notes: **Correct public links.** The upstream image builds webhook, form and OAuth callback URLs from `WEBHOOK_URL` and defaults to `http://localhost:5678/`, which no other device can reach. `src/entrypoint.sh` reads an optional `public-url.txt` from the application data folder and passes it to n8n, so the setting lives in the data volume and survives container updates.
**Login works over plain HTTP.** `N8N_SECURE_COOKIE=false`, because TOS opens the app as `http://<NAS-IP>:<port>` and a `Secure` cookie would be dropped by the browser, making login loop.
**Timezone.** `TZ` and `GENERIC_TIMEZONE` are both set, so Schedule triggers fire at the local time instead of the upstream `America/New_York` default.

**Readiness probe.** The healthcheck uses n8n's own readiness endpoint (`/healthz/readiness`): it answers 503 while the database migrations still run and 200 only when the instance can serve traffic, so the container is not reported healthy before it is usable (`start_period: 120s` covers a slow disk on the first start).
limitations: Webhook, form and OAuth callback links are built from the public base URL. Until you set one in `public-url.txt` they use `http://localhost:5678/` and only work on the NAS itself.
The bundled database is SQLite inside the application data folder. For heavy or multi-user workloads n8n supports an external PostgreSQL; that requires editing `docker-compose.yml`.
The app is served over plain HTTP on the LAN. Do not expose the published port to the internet; put it behind a TLS reverse proxy if you need remote access.

runtime_files.lifecycle: never overwritten; the app owns it

runtime_files.growth: one entry per installed community node

zh-cn.descript: n8n 是自托管的工作流自动化平台。你可以在可视化画布上把 400 多个应用、数据库与 AI 模型连接起来，自动完成重复性工作：同步文件、发送通知、执行定时任务、加工数据，只在需要时写少量代码。本应用在 NAS 上以非 root 容器运行 Docker Hub 官方镜像，所有工作流、凭据与执行历史都保存在应用数据目录中，重启与更新都不会丢失。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺失时应用中心会自动提示安装）。镜像在安装时从 Docker Hub 拉取；若 NAS 无法直连 Docker Hub，请先在 DockerEngine 中配置镜像加速。工作流、凭据、SQLite 数据库与加密密钥都保存在应用数据目录，卸载并删除数据前请先备份；加密密钥一旦丢失，已保存的凭据将无法解密。Webhook、表单与 OAuth 链接默认使用 http://localhost:5678，如需从其他设备访问，请把数据目录中 public-url.txt 里的地址取消注释并重启应用。
zh-cn.release_note: 1. 首次发布：来自 Docker Hub 的 n8n 2.41.3，以非 root 容器运行；工作流、凭据与执行历史保存在应用数据目录。

zh-hk.descript: n8n 是自架式工作流自動化平台。你可以在視覺化畫布上把 400 多個應用程式、資料庫與 AI 模型連接起來，自動完成重複性工作：同步檔案、發送通知、執行排程任務、加工資料，只在需要時寫少量程式碼。本應用在 NAS 上以非 root 容器執行 Docker Hub 官方映像，所有工作流、憑證與執行歷史都保存在應用資料目錄中，重新啟動與更新都不會遺失。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺少時應用中心會自動提示安裝）。映像在安裝時從 Docker Hub 下載；若 NAS 無法直連 Docker Hub，請先在 DockerEngine 中設定映像加速。工作流、憑證、SQLite 資料庫與加密金鑰都保存在應用資料目錄，解除安裝並刪除資料前請先備份；加密金鑰一旦遺失，已儲存的憑證將無法解密。Webhook、表單與 OAuth 連結預設使用 http://localhost:5678，如需從其他裝置存取，請把應用資料目錄中 public-url.txt 裡的位址取消註解並重新啟動應用。
zh-hk.release_note: 1. 首次發佈：來自 Docker Hub 的 n8n 2.41.3，以非 root 容器執行；工作流、憑證與執行歷史保存在應用資料目錄。
